description: This file defines a singleton object 'WakeWords' containing constants and utility functions for parsing and sanitizing wake word lists used in the application.

methods.name: parseCommaSeparated
methods.description: Splits an input string by commas, trims whitespace, and filters out empty entries.

methods.name: parseIfChanged
methods.description: Parses input string into list of words and returns the new list if it differs from current; otherwise returns null.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Cleans and trims a list of words, enforces maximum count and length, and defaults if the result is empty.
